scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/.well-known dist/account dist/admin dist/assets dist/bookings dist/collection dist/delivery dist/menu dist/orders && cp index.html 404.html offline.html styles.css client-tools.js home.js sw.js manifest.webmanifest icon-192.png icon-512.png robots.txt sitemap.xml _headers dist/ && cp .well-known/security.txt dist/.well-known/ && cp account/index.html account/account.js dist/account/ && cp admin/index.html admin/admin.js dist/admin/ && cp assets/*.jpg assets/*.png assets/*.svg assets/*.webp dist/assets/ && cp bookings/index.html bookings/bookings.js dist/bookings/ && cp collection/index.html dist/collection/ && cp delivery/index.html dist/delivery/ && cp menu/index.html menu/menu.js dist/menu/ && cp orders/*.js dist/orders/ && for directory in privacy terms refunds; do if [ -f "$directory/index.html" ]; then mkdir -p "dist/$directory" && cp "$directory/index.html" "dist/$directory/"; fi; done
scripts.check: npm test && npm run check:js && npm run build
